injuries.detail: Nembhard is questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to left hip soreness.
McConnell (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.
Nesmith (hand) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com repor
Embiid (right foot injury management) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pacers.
Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
